name: Vivanza Biosciences Limited
about: Vivanza Biosciences Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products in India. It offers pharmaceuticals in various categories; injectable products, including antifungals, antibiotics, antivirals, and other products for hospital and clinical use; Vivanza medical gloves for medical and surgical use; therapeutic index injection; and veterinary products and feed. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
